changes.text: Good catch on the flat-composition replay vector (nc-08)—that confirms why §7 keeps the rail nonce slot strictly equal to B and pushes any multi-extension composition upstream into paymentId before B is derived. Agreed on adding that explicit single-sentence invariant in §7 and aligning §6's paymentId length floor to 16 characters (16..64) to match payment-identifier.
